newsitem.title: USA: Mich. unemployment rate stays at 4 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Mich. unemployment rate stays at 4 percent in June.

text.p: Michigan's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remained at a record low 4 percent for June, the state employment security agency reported Wednesday.
While the rate remained unchanged from May, the actual number of unemployed residents dropped in June to its lowest point in 24 years, the agency reported.
A total of 196,000 workers were unemployed in June, the lowest number since 195,000 went without work in April 1973, the agency reported.
The jobless rate was down from 4.8 percent reported a year ago in part on continued increases in the construction, services and retail trade sectors, the agency reported.
Gains were offset by declines in manufacturing, government and the finance, insurance and real estate sectors, the agency reported.
